login.title: Ukungena komlingani wetjhaneli
login.welcome: Siyakwamukela! Ngena ngemvume ukulawula ama-lead wakho.
login.heroTitle: Khulisa ibhizinisi lakho lezakhiwo ngawo woke ama-lead owaletha
login.heroIntro: I-portal eyodwa yokubhalisa amakhasimende nabakhi, gcina isikweletu sama-leads wakho begodu ubalandele ukubhukha.

protect.title: Ukuvikelwa okuphindaphindiweko
protect.text: I-lead yakho ihlala ngeyakho isikhathi sokuvikeleka, njeke akekho omunye umuntu ongafuna ikhasimende elifanako.

track.title: Landelela zoke iingaba
track.text: Bona ubujamo bomkhokheli ngamunye nomlando opheleleko, kusukela ekuthomeni kokuthoma ukuya ekubhukheni.

handover.title: Isikwelede ngesikhathi sokubhukha
handover.text: Lokha ikhasimende nalibhukhako, i-lead inikelwa umakhi wena urekhodwe njengomlingani womthombo.

login.secure: Ukungena ngokuphepha - imininingwana yamakhasimende wakho ihlala iyimfihlo

signup.title: Ukutloliswa komlingani wetjhaneli
signup.intro: Yenza i-akhawunti yakho ukuthoma ukurejista nokuphatha ama-lead wakho.
